//: kowloon-building controls that recreate the reference shop house bay by bay (the authored model="reference-corner"), from that model's own numbers. Edge 0 is the front, edge 1 the right side from the cut corner; storey 0 is the ground floor. The back and left edges are left to the seed, behind slices of their neighbours.
/corner: The street corner is rounded with a radius of 0.55 m (one smooth surface of ten chords), and the green mosaic band runs through it. The front's wall ends 0.55 m before the corner (at 9.25 m) and the side's starts 0.55 m after it, so the front's wide bank and shop end at 8.75 m.
/facade: Thin string courses and no hood line; a tall parapet without a rail; green mosaic only under the wide right bank and round onto the side.
/plinth: A dark plinth 1 m high along both street fronts and 1.5 m on the corner drum.
/shops: Front: a closed gate bay under a sagging green tarp on poles, then the open provisions shop under the striped canvas. Side: a gate and the open hardware shop.
/awning stripes: The striped canvas in about 11 cm stripes (awningStripePlans: stripes of each colour per bay, 0 the seed's width), so its valance has 25 scallops; the tarps keep their default sag (awningSagPlans: m, 0 the default).
/neighbours: The back and the left edge are party edges: a slice of an adjoining building stands against each, three storeys at the back and two on the left, so the upper storeys' fixtures still show above them (partyPlans per edge: none, wall or stub; partyStoreyPlans: a stub's storeys, 0 the seed's).
/clutter: Crates and cartons stacked to the left of the front's gate and round the corner on the side street; the gates are galvanised: wide lattice bars (gateBars) over closed sheet steel leaves a little darker than the lattice (gateBacking), both light enough to read grey in the tarp's shade.
/fixtures: Rusty cages holding old window units on storey 2's left and middle banks and storey 3's middle one; split condensers at window height over the lower right corner of the wide bank. fixtureAtPlans moves a bank's fixture: [m along the bank from its centre, m of its foot above the sill].
/cages: Welded of few heavy bars painted a rusty off-white, drawn bolder than life so they read from the street: bar and frame-rail thickness and bar spacing in m; rust is the most the seed mixes into the paint.
/tank: A ribbed galvanised water tank about 2.4 m tall right of the stair hut: shell radius and height, stand height, ribs and conical lid rise.
/sashes: Banks narrower than 2.4 m have three lights across and a mid rail. Lights standing open per bank (the seed's elsewhere), a louvred top light at the right of the wide bank, lit rooms, and diamond grilles over the upper half of the windows beside the balcony door (windowsPlans).
/balcony: Per edge: from, to, depth, and where its fan-shaped divider stands. The door to it is in storey 1's wall.
/canopies: Corrugated hoods over these window banks (edge, storey, bank).
/services: Drain pipes at these distances along each edge; conduits as [x, z, rise, run, rise2].
/cables: Per edge: x0, z0, x1, z1, sag, distance from the wall at the far end, cables in the bundle, radius of the corner it rounds (x1 is then measured on round it), junction boxes (0 none, 1 start, 2 end, 3 both). Front: from the 永昌藥行 bracket and a junction box to the conduit's pier, on round the corner, and up to the top storey's condenser. Side: from the conduit to the 電器修理 pole, and a pair under the top storey.
/roof: A rail on the rear and left parapets only (roofRailPlan: the share of each edge's parapet that carries one); vent stubs along the right, a few pipes along the rear parapet, pots at the front and a cable from the aerial to the stair hut (roofClutter).
